messages:
CI Bot: nightly-perf-ci detected p95 regression on small-batch bench (model: gpt-small-8k, workload: small-batch). delta: +18% vs baseline. build: a1b2c3f. report: https://ci.redwood/3123456789/report
Alex R: ack — looking. Is this across all kernels or only CUDA/aten?
Maria G: I see the spike mirrored in the redis-backed kvcache test. p95 tail aligns with eviction windows.
Raj P: can someone grab a perf sample / Flamegraph from the failing shard? `perf record -g` or `objdump`-level stacks would help.
Alex R: repro command here: `./bench/run --model gpt-small-8k --batch 4 --seq 1024 --profile` on nightly image `redwood/runtime:nightly-a1b2c3f`.
Jing L: I'm spinning up a repro VM (r5g-large) and will attach the logs.
CI Bot: trace artifact uploaded: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/3123456789/trace.tar.gz
Sam T: FYI PR #8423 (mempool reorg) landed into main yesterday — might be the suspect. Can we try toggling mempool mode?
Maria G: good call. We see eviction-heavy patterns in the timeline around the p95 spikes.
Raj P: I'll run a kernel sampling + flamegraph on the repro. ETA 25m.
Alex R: watch for syscalls and page-fault clusters — mempool changes often surface there.
Jing L: initial logs uploaded: https://files.redwood/jing/logs-3123456789.tar.gz
Sam T: starting a canary with `--mempool=legacy` on pool-qa-3. will post metrics in ~20m.
Raj P: flamegraph uploaded: https://files.redwood/jing/fg-3123456789.svg — hotspots in `memory_alloc_batch` and `kvcache::evict_batch`.
Alex R: that lines up with mempool/eviction interplay. Good find.
Maria G: proposed bisect: 1) kernel sample on current commit, 2) rollback mempool reorg on a canary, 3) re-run nightly bench, compare p95 and allocation traces.
Raj P: I'm taking step 1 and producing perf + folded stacks.
Alex R: ops, can you help with step 2 (rollback candidate) so we get a clean compare?
ops-bot: rollback job queued: https://ci.redwood/jobs/rollback-3123456789 — starting on pool-qa-3.
Sam T: rollback job started. I'll monitor and report once the bench completes.
Maria G: quick check after the rollback (n=30 samples): p95 returned to baseline within noise. Needs longer run but promising.
Alex R: excellent. If this holds, PR #8423 is the regression source. Let's pin mempool config for nightly until we have a root cause.
Raj P: I'll open a revert PR that also adds a regression test targeting kvcache eviction patterns.
Jing L: filing a perf board task PERF-321 to track follow-up work and test coverage.
Alex R: thanks all. moving this into monitoring for the next 2 nightly runs; if stable we'll close. :thumbsup:
